executionAndAcceptance: Start bounded recovery immediately in parallel. Exact original denomination leaf linked to the same claim; constructed GCU and local valuation do not prove history. If unrecoverable, retain UNKNOWN and publish recovery evidence; do not silently redefine this field.
proposedOwners: G 主责，D 协助来源恢复
executionAndAcceptanceZh: 立即并行开展有界原始来源恢复。新造 GCU 本金和本币账面估值都不能恢复历史币种。找不到时保留 UNKNOWN，列出已查来源与待找证据。

executionAndAcceptance: Adopt explicit coverage, quality, exact period and physical recipe. Preserve extreme postwar geography/resource constraints. A chosen floor may be infeasible: report shortage, never increase resources to make it feasible.
proposedOwners: C 主责，A 协助规则接入
executionAndAcceptanceZh: 不得为了让底线可达而抹平战后极端差异、改变地理或增补不存在的资源；底线不可达时报告真实缺口。

executionAndAcceptance: Adopt beneficiary/base/trigger/precision and explicit free/fixed/fractional policy (70). Then derive non-overlapping native charges from events and source schedules (70). No default free policy.
proposedOwners: C 主责，G 协助费用条款
executionAndAcceptanceZh: 先采用 70 项 feePolicy，再依真实计费事件计算 70 项 feeTotalNative。未知费率不能默认为免费。

executionAndAcceptance: Adopt buffer days/legal minimum and shortfall priority. Derive retained cash without overlapping frozen/pledged/earmarked amounts. No new payable, creditor or cash.
proposedOwners: C 主责，F 协助现金限制
executionAndAcceptanceZh: 缓冲与冻结、抵押、专款集合须去重；保留现金不是新增债务或新增资金。

executionAndAcceptance: Freeze exact four-claim lifecycle: dates, coupon, grace, late/default, call, partial payment, refunds; preserve principals and references. TIME360 is day-count, not automatic maturity.
executionAndAcceptanceZh: 完整冻结四笔债权起息、票息、期限、宽限、晚付、违约、赎回、部分支付、退款条款。TIME360 不是到期期限。

executionAndAcceptance: Bind each legal entity to immutable source-admitted CASH account and actual inactive-opening World/genesis/head, currency and value date. Economic-owner mapping can proceed before player assignment, but cannot invent account identity/admission.
proposedOwners: F 主责，A 协助身份与准入
executionAndAcceptanceZh: 可先完成经济机构与账户映射，不等待玩家招募；但必须有真实的未启动开局身份、不可变账户与来源准入，不能临时编造账户 ID。

executionAndAcceptance: Reconcile opening + settled inflows - settled outflows = closing by same native account/currency/date. Available = balance minus evidenced UNION of restrictions. Unknown overlaps stay unknown. No TGA/reserve pooling, receivable-to-cash conversion, FX=1, zero clipping or new wealth plug.
proposedOwners: F 主责，G 协助资金来源
executionAndAcceptanceZh: 同账户同币种同价值日校验：期初现金加已结算流入减已结算流出等于期末现金；可用额扣除限制集合的并集。不得把应收、贷款承诺、储备、TGA 或估值冒充现金。

executionAndAcceptance: Build 350 bounded complete registers, then classify 70 country obligation sets and derive 140 totals. Show source coverage, legal basis, commitment, due, payer, currency, period, already-settled state and unique obligation identity. Two GOV-CB contracts or four mirror pairs do not prove completeness.
proposedOwners: C 主责，G 协助法律和合同
executionAndAcceptanceZh: 先完成 350 项完整义务登记，再完成 70 项分类和 140 项金额。两条政府债务合同或四组镜像不能证明所有义务齐全。

executionAndAcceptance: Verify both legal roles and same instrument identity, independent title/admission evidence, correct asset/liability sides. D48 only supplies constructed candidate leaves. Scenario adoption, if chosen, needs a new explicit version and must not impersonate historical title.
proposedOwners: G 主责，A 协助实体准入
executionAndAcceptanceZh: D48 的 48 个源叶只支持候选准备；不自动证明法律权属。资产方与负债方角色、工具身份必须逐一核对。

executionAndAcceptance: Approved skill-hour recipe and actual available hours; posts are not hours. Payroll = source hours times native wage plus distinct statutory costs; exact period/payer and no duplicate labour costs.
proposedOwners: C 主责，D 协助物理配方
executionAndAcceptanceZh: 岗位人数不是工时；技能、工资、法定附加、期间及付款人要有来源，并排除其他成本内重复劳动支出。

executionAndAcceptance: Approved potable service recipe plus rights, quality, treatment/loss and accepted net delivery. Raw-water allocations are not potable delivery. Inclusive tariff OR disjoint labour/energy/chemical/maintenance costs.
proposedOwners: D 主责，C 协助成本
executionAndAcceptanceZh: 原水额度、处理能力不等于饮用水净交付；权利、质量、损耗、验收及成本须分别有证据。

executionAndAcceptance: Integrate essential approved MW load over actual simulation hours into MWh, validate dispatch/loss/accepted delivery. Capacity or unenergized candidate grid is not delivery. Inclusive tariff OR disjoint input costs.
proposedOwners: D 主责，C 协助成本
executionAndAcceptanceZh: MW 容量不是 MWh 交付；必须按实际模拟小时积分并核验调度和损耗。未通电候选电网不能充当已交付电力。

executionAndAcceptance: Accepted titled tonnes times verified route km, correct mode/period. Planned/in-transit goods are not arrivals. Native freight rate plus only excluded non-overlapping costs.
proposedOwners: D 主责，C 协助成本
executionAndAcceptanceZh: 计划、在途不是到货；用已验收吨数乘有据路线公里，再结合原币合同运价及未包含的独立费用。

executionAndAcceptance: Derive from adopted terms, actual opening Clock/epoch mapping and unpaid historical state. Check boundary dates; no first-year interest accelerated to Day0. Inactive relative schedules may be prepared but do not close actualDue.
proposedOwners: G 主责，A 协助时间绑定
executionAndAcceptanceZh: 可以先准备未启动相对日历；原字段仍需实际开局 epoch/Clock 绑定及历史未付状态。首年票息不得整体提前到 Day0。

executionAndAcceptance: Bind legal payer/payee to two compatible source-admitted accounts, same currency/value date and proven availability, plus current authority when used. Mirror entries do not create settlement backing.
proposedOwners: G 主责，F 协助账户
executionAndAcceptanceZh: 双方账户的币种、所有权、价值日、可用资金和执行时权限必须一致；镜像不创造清算资金。

executionAndAcceptance: Requires actual AuthSubject, current team/seat/membership and Office/capability/revocation revision at World/head. Resolve with existing server chain; re-resolve at commit. Keep 350 entity currentPermission and 70 country discretionaryAuthorization pending until real assignments are known. Unassigned/denied is distinct from a fabricated active subject.
proposedOwners: A 主责，F 协助实体映射
executionAndAcceptanceZh: 420 项直接依赖真实当前主体及职位授权：350 项实体 currentPermission 和 70 项国家 discretionaryAuthorization。可先做解析器、映射和反例校验；不能用候选名单、NPC 标签或虚构成员来关闭。

executionAndAcceptance: Only after terms/accounts/authority: bind existing writer/command/head/fence/idempotency atomic route. Independent review and exact COMMITTED receipt required for original field closure. Static DTO, test fixture, dry run or route existence alone is insufficient. Do not start World or execute live payment merely to remove UNKNOWN without applicable authorization.
proposedOwners: A 主责，G 协助债权绑定
executionAndAcceptanceZh: 复用现有权威执行器；须有准确命令、writer、head、fence、幂等与原子路由绑定，以及该批次 COMMITTED 凭据。DTO、测试夹具或干跑不够；不得仅为清空未知而擅自启动 World 或执行真实付款。
